title: Enhancing Bug-Exposing Test Generation via Step-Level Credit Assignment and Self-Distillation from Valuable Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.27694v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models have shown strong code generation capabilities, yet their outputs often contain subtle bugs. Automatically repairing such code requires informative tests: inputs that expose faulty behavior, paired with correct expected outputs. Recent RL-based test generation methods apply the same outcome reward to all reasoning steps, which can discourage useful reasoning and reinforce flawed steps. They also fail to effectively learn from trajectories that find bug-triggering inputs but predict incorrect outputs, leaving their verified bug-triggering progress insufficiently exploited. To address these limitations, we propose SCALF, a process-supervised RL approach that combines Step-level Credit Assignment with targeted Learning from valuable Failed trajectories. translated_title: 通过步骤级信用分配与从有价值失败中自蒸馏来增强暴露缺陷的测试生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型已展现出强大的代码生成能力，但其输出往往包含细微的缺陷。自动修复此类代码需要信息丰富的测试用例：即能够暴露错误行为的输入，并配以正确的预期输出。近期基于强化学习的测试生成方法对所有推理步骤施加相同的结果奖励，这可能会抑制有用的推理并强化有缺陷的步骤。此外，这些方法未能有效地从那些找到触发缺陷的输入但预测了错误输出的轨迹中学习，导致其已验证的触发缺陷进展未得到充分利用。为解决这些局限，我们提出了SCALF，一种将步骤级信用分配与针对有价值失败轨迹进行定向学习相结合的过程监督强化学习方法。SCALF从过程奖励中推导出步骤特定的优势，使每个推理阶段都能获得自己的学习信号。它进一步将那些暴露（注：原始摘要在此处被截断，内容不完整）
tldr: SCALF提出了一种过程监督强化学习方法，通过步骤级信用分配让每个推理步骤获得独立的学习信号，并从找到触发缺陷输入但预测错误输出的有价值失败轨迹中进行自蒸馏学习，从而显著增强了暴露Bug的测试生成效果。
en_tdlr: SCALF is a process-supervised RL approach that enhances bug-exposing test generation by deriving step-specific advantages from process rewards and self-distilling from valuable failed trajectories that expose bugs but predict incorrect outputs.
